pages.ja:
「………………よし」
中の様子を見よう。
消えた食パンの行方も突き止めなければならないし、遠坂がいなければ捜しに出ないといけないし。

pages.en:
“…………Good.”

I'll look inside.

I need to discover what became of the missing bread. And if Tohsaka is gone, I need to search for her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……All right.”
I’ll look inside.
I have to find out where the bread went, and I’ll have to go look for her if Tohsaka’s not in her room.

pages.ja:
なぜか緊張して中に入った。
「あー、もしもし……？」
小声で中の様子を窺うも、一向に返事はなし。
pages.jaRuby:
なぜか緊張して中に入った。
「あー、もしもし……？」
小声で中の様子を窺うも、一向に返事はなし。
pages.en:
For some reason, I enter with my nerves on edge.

“Um… hello?”

I call softly into the room, but receive no answer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
I go in nervously.
“Um, excuse me…?”
I ask in a whisper, but there’s no reply.

pages.ja:
「
なんだ。やっぱりいないじゃんか」
いやもう、客間は客間だった。
変わった様子は一つもない。
ある物と言えば、テーブルの上に置かれた謎の正方形だけだ。
pages.jaRuby:
「

ある物と言えば、テーブルの上に置かれた謎の正方形だけだ。
pages.en:
“——What? She isn't here after all.”

The guest room is simply a guest room.

Nothing appears out of place.

The only unusual object is a mysterious square upon the table.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Oh, she’s not in here, like I thought.”
The guest room is the same as always.
There’s nothing strange here.
The only thing here is a mysterious rectangular object on the table.

pages.ja:
「……なんだろ、これ」
大きさ、縦横ともに十五センチ弱、厚さにして六センチ強。プラスチック製で、パッと見弁当箱に見えない事もない。
pages.jaRuby:
「……なんだろ、これ」

pages.en:
“…What's this?”

Just under fifteen centimeters on each side and a little over six centimeters deep. Plastic. At a glance, it might almost be a lunchbox.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…What is this?”
The length and width are about 15 centimeters, and it’s 6 centimeters tall. It’s made of plastic and it looks like a lunchbox.

pages.ja:
「じゃなくて、弁当箱だろこれ」
それが三段重ねられている。
用途も意図もてんで不明だ。
pages.jaRuby:
「じゃなくて、弁当箱だろこれ」
それが三段重ねられている。
用途も意図もてんで不明だ。
pages.en:
“No, it is a lunchbox.”

Three tiers have been stacked together.

Their purpose and meaning are entirely beyond me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Actually, it is a lunchbox.”
There’s three of them.
I have no idea what it’s used for or why.

pages.ja:
「遠坂のやつ、なんだってこんなものを」
気になって手を伸ばす。
と。
「え？」
ごろん、と背後で物音がした。
pages.jaRuby:
「遠坂のやつ、なんだってこんなものを」
気になって手を伸ばす。
と。
「え？」
ごろん、と背後で物音がした。
pages.en:
“Why would Tohsaka leave something like this…?”

Curiosity draws my hand toward it.

——Then.

“What?”

A soft rustle comes from behind me—the sound of something rolling over.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Why does Tohsaka…”
I reach out, curious.
Then.
“Huh?”
I hear a sound behind me.

pages.ja:
「ん…………」
小さな吐息。
朝日が眩しいのか、寝苦しそうに身をよじって、それは、こっちに体を向けてきた。
pages.jaRuby:
「ん…………」
小さな吐息。
朝日が眩しいのか、寝苦しそうに身をよじって、それは、こっちに体を向けてきた。
pages.en:
“Mm…………”

A little breath.

Perhaps the morning sun troubles her. She shifts restlessly in her sleep and turns toward me.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hm……”
The faint sound of breathing.
It twists its body and faces in my direction, perhaps because of the bright light.

pages.ja:
一瞬で思考が漂白した。
もう真っ白。
呼吸なんざ速攻で止まったし、眼球は固定されたままピクリとも動かない。

pages.en:
Every thought in my head is bleached away in an instant.

Pure white.

My breathing stops at once. My eyes fix in place and refuse to move.
pages.mirrorMoon:
All thoughts vanish in an instant.
My mind turns white.
My breathing stops instantly, and I can’t look away.

pages.ja:
「っ、
、っ」
ごくり、と喉が動く。
音を立てたらまずい、なんて思わなかった。
うるさいっていうんなら、心臓の音の方がうるさい。
pages.jaRuby:

うるさいっていうんなら、心臓の音の方がうるさい。
pages.en:
“—— ——”

My throat moves in a dry swallow.

The thought that making a sound might be dangerous never even occurs to me.

If anything is making too much noise, it is my heart.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
!”
My throat gulps.
I don’t think it’ll be bad if I make a sound.
If you’re talking about loud, my heart is loud.
It’s pounding like mad. If I have to make a comparison, it’s as loud as a train.

「
っ」
いや落ち着け。
冷静に、冷静に。
今回ばかりは失敗は許されない。
今後の協力関係を円滑にする為には、何事もなかったように部屋を立ち去るのみだ。
ここで遠坂に目を覚まされたら命はないっぽいし、これ以上、その
遠坂を見ていたら、協力関係なんて、続けられなくなる。

pages.en:
“——”

No. Calm down.

Remain calm. Perfectly calm.

This time, failure is not permitted.

If our alliance is to continue smoothly, I must leave the room as though nothing happened.

If Tohsaka wakes now, I will probably die. And if I keep looking at her any longer, our alliance will become impossible for an entirely different reason.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
!”
No, calm down.
Calm down, calm down.
I can’t afford a mistake.
I have to leave this room quietly, as if nothing has happened, if I wish for our future cooperation to continue peacefully.
I’ll probably be killed if Tohsaka wakes up right now, and
um
I won’t be able to cooperate with her if I keep watching Tohsaka.

pages.ja: 「ん……ちょっと、ごめん……もうすこし、かかるってば……」
pages.jaRuby: 「ん……ちょっと、ごめん……もうすこし、かかるってば……」
pages.en: “Mm… I'm sorry… I said it would take a little longer…”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Hm… Sorry… it’ll a take a while…”

pages.ja:
「っ…………！」
びくん、と体が後じさる。
……遠坂はまだ眠っている。
眠りは深い方なのか、放っておけばずっと眠っていそうな感じだ。
pages.jaRuby:
「っ…………！」
びくん、と体が後じさる。
……遠坂はまだ眠っている。
眠りは深い方なのか、放っておけばずっと眠っていそうな感じだ。
pages.en:
“…………!”

My body jerks backward.

…Tohsaka is still asleep.

She must sleep deeply. Left alone, she looks capable of remaining this way forever.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“……!”
My body jumps.
…Tohsaka’s still asleep.
She must be well off in her dreams, as it looks like she’ll continue to sleep on.

pages.ja:
「
ふう」
胸を撫でおろして、少しずつ後退する。
……その間。
見るべきじゃないって分かっているのに、視線は遠坂から離れなかった。
pages.jaRuby:

見るべきじゃないって分かっているのに、視線は遠坂から離れなかった。
pages.en:
“——Phew.”

I stroke my chest and begin retreating inch by inch.

…All the while, though I know I should not look, my eyes refuse to leave her.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Phew.”
I sigh and slowly retreat.
…All the while…
I know I shouldn’t be watching, but my eyes will not move away from Tohsaka.

pages.ja:
……そこにあるのは、本当に、ただの女の子の眠りだった。
魔術師とかマスターとか、そんな肩書きは嘘だったんじゃないかっていうぐらい、遠坂は女の子だった。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
…What lies before me is, truly, nothing more than a sleeping girl.

She looks so wholly like a girl that “mage” and “Master” might both have been lies.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…A girl is there sleeping.
Tohsaka is a girl, and it makes me forget that she’s a magus and a Master.

Her uneasy breathing. Her rumpled nightclothes.

After seeing her this way, I will never be able to speak to her naturally again——

Her breath and her disordered pajamas.

This is almost unfair.
If I see such a thing, I won’t be able to talk to her naturally like I’ve been doing up to now

pages.en: “Ah… mm… bright…”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Ah… hm, so bright…”

っ」
無防備な寝顔。

……一体、どのくらいの時間がかかったのか。
たった二メートルの距離はとんでもなく長く、破裂寸前の心臓を押さえたまま廊下に滑り出る。

pages.en:
“——————!”

Her unguarded sleeping face.

Unable to tear my eyes away, I retreat toward the door one agonizing fraction at a time.

…I cannot tell how long it takes.

The mere two meters feel endless. Clutching a heart on the verge of bursting, I finally slip into the corridor.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
!”
A defenseless sleeping face.
I slowly retreat to the door, not being able to look away from her.
…How long did it take me?
The two meters were infinitely long and I slide out to the hallway with an almost-exploding heart.

は」
そうして深呼吸。
止めに止めていた呼吸を再開する。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“Haaaaah————”

I draw a deep breath.

My lungs resume the labor I had forced them to suspend.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Haa
Haa.”
And I take a deep breath.
I release the breath I held for so long.

pages.ja:

「
ああもう。なんだよ、いったい」
……いや、なんだよも何も、全面的に俺が悪い。
俺が悪いんだけど、少しは情状酌量の余地ってもんがあるんではなかろうか。

pages.en:
The strength goes from my knees, and I collapse onto the floor.

“——What in the world was that?”

…No. Whatever it was, the fault lies entirely with me.

I am at fault, certainly. But surely there is room for a little mercy under the circumstances.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My knees give way and I fall onto the floor.
“
Man, what the hell…?”
…Well, it’s all my fault.
It’s my fault, but shouldn’t extenuating circumstances be taken into consideration?

「
悪い、遠坂」
心底から呟いた途端、どっと疲れた。
「……はあ」
まあ、ともかく。
窒息死する前に外に出られて、本当に助かった……。

pages.en:
“——————————Sorry, Tohsaka.”

The heartfelt apology leaves me suddenly exhausted.

“…Phew.”

In any case.

Thank goodness I escaped before I suffocated.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
I’m sorry, Tohsaka.”
As I murmur, fatigue assails me.
“…Man.”
Well, anyway…
I’m glad I got out before I died of lack of oxygen…

pages.ja:
……とにかく、朝食を作る事にした。
細かく手の込んだ料理を作っていれば高ぶった気持ちも落ち着くし、朝飯が美味ければ遠坂も喜ぶだろうし、一石二鳥だ。

pages.en:
…I decide to make breakfast.

Preparing something intricate will calm my agitation, and a delicious breakfast will please Tohsaka. Two problems solved at once.
pages.mirrorMoon:
…I decide to go cook breakfast.
It’ll be killing two birds with one stone, because making breakfast will calm down my mind and Tohsaka will be happy if it tastes good.

pages.ja: 「おはようございます、シロウ。今朝は随分とゆっくりなのですね」
pages.jaRuby: 「おはようございます、シロウ。今朝は随分とゆっくりなのですね」
pages.en: “Good morning, Shirou. You are taking things unusually slowly today.”
pages.mirrorMoon: “Good morning, Shirou. You are at ease this morning.”

ジャガイモの皮を剥きながら挨拶をする。

pages.en:
“Hm? Morning, Saber. It's Sunday, so there's no school. We can afford to take our time. I'm feeling well too, so we'll go to the dojo after breakfast.”

I greet her while peeling a potato.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Hm? Oh, morning, Saber. I can relax since it’s Sunday and there’s no school today. I feel good, so let’s go to the dojo after breakfast.”
I greet her while I peel some potatoes.

pages.ja:
「ええ、望むところです。ではシロウ、半身の麻痺は完治したのですね」
「あ、そう言えばそうだった。寝てたら治ってた。まだかすかに重いけど、この分なら明日には治ってるさ」
pages.jaRuby:
「ええ、望むところです。ではシロウ、半身の麻痺は完治したのですね」

pages.en:
“Yes, gladly. Then the paralysis affecting half your body has healed completely?”

“Oh, right. I almost forgot. Sleeping fixed it. That side still feels faintly heavy, but at this rate I'll be normal by tomorrow.”
pages.mirrorMoon:
“Yes, that will be great. So your numbness has healed?”
“Oh, you’re right. It healed while I was sleeping. It’s a bit heavy, but it should be fully healed by tomorrow.”

pages.ja:
「それは良かった。貴方が傷を負ったままでは私も立つ瀬がない。シロウがいつも通り厨房に立っていると、私も安心できます」
セイバーはテーブルの横、自分の定位置に腰を下ろす。

セイバーはテーブルの横、自分の定位置に腰を下ろす。
pages.en:
“That is a relief. I could hardly hold my head high while you—my Master—remained injured. Seeing Shirou standing in the kitchen as always reassures me as well.”

Saber takes her customary seat beside the table.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“That is good. I cannot be at ease if my Master is wounded. I can relax if I see you in the kitchen like always.”
Saber takes a seat in her usual position beside the table.

pages.ja:

藤ねえと遠坂が起きてこないのは寝坊と言わざるを得ないが、今日に限っては強く言えない。

pages.en:
It is half past eight.

There is no avoiding the conclusion that Fuji and Tohsaka have both overslept, though today of all days I cannot reproach them too harshly.
pages.mirrorMoon:
It’s eight-thirty.
Fuji-nee and Tohsaka are sleeping in, but I can’t complain today.

さっきまで頭にちらついていた遠坂の寝顔も、今はじゃがいもと玉ねぎによって薄れているし。
pages.jaRuby:
「

pages.en:
“——Exactly. Thanks to this, I'm finally starting to forget.”

Tohsaka's sleeping face had haunted me until moments ago, but potatoes and onions are gradually driving it from my mind.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Yeah. And thanks to that, I’m starting to forget about it too.”
Tohsaka’s sleeping face is being replaced with potatoes and onions.
